ModMetaData.author: Rick
ModMetaData.name: ESCP - Minotaurs
ModMetaData.description: The Elder Scrolls Collaboration Project Presents: Minotaurs, the bull-headed children of Morihaus. They are rare, strong and quick to anger. They cannot read, make art or bargain, and no ordinary helm or boot fits them. Most of Tamriel treats them as beasts. A few have learned to live among men.
